description.text: Program Description Biomedical engineering is a discipline that solves related problems in medicine, safeguards human health, and serves for the prevention, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of diseases. It is a highly integrated interdisciplinary subject, which is its biggest characteristic. Biomedical engineering its theories and methods of the integrated engineering, biology and medicine, on all levels to study the change of state of human body system, and using the engineering technology to control this kind of change of biomedical engineering professional training with life science, electronic technology, computer technology and information science on the basis of theoretical knowledge and the combination of medicine and engineering scientific research ability, can in the field of biomedical engineering, medical instruments and other electronic technology, computer technology and information industry departments engaged in research, development, teaching and management of senior engineering and technical personnel. Future Career Student employment mainly go to research institutions, the hospital image, equipment, clinical engineering, information center and other related departments, medical apparatus and instruments related enterprises, institutions, government management departments, etc. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Biomedical Engineering at Beihang University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant should have a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree or have the equivalent educational background of (a B.S.) degree. 3.The applicant should be forty years of age or under. 4.The applicant must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English
